platform_copies.editorial_angle: Corporate understatement: one neutral noun covering three leadership changes
platform_copies.speaker_perspective: dry tech-business observer reading a corporate release
platform_copies.satire_target: the company's communications language, not the people or allegations
platform_copies.semantic_bridge: The word “transition” compresses the CEO resignation, interim appointment and first board chair into one tidy corporate noun.
platform_copies.news_counterfactual: Without the CEO resignation and interim succession, “transition” would be routine wording and the understatement would disappear.
platform_copies.video_counterfactual: Unrelated footage would remove the visual escalation metaphor; the news-based line would remain legible but lose its second layer.

public_fields.post_text: One CEO out, an interim CEO in, and a new board chair. “Transition” is doing a heroic amount of work in that press release.

platform_copies.editorial_angle: The org chart as the person forced to process the handover
platform_copies.speaker_perspective: the overworked org chart speaking to camera
platform_copies.satire_target: the workload hidden by the calm word “transition”
platform_copies.semantic_bridge: Three leadership-role changes make a neutral announcement sound like a very busy day for the org chart.
platform_copies.news_counterfactual: Without the CEO exit, interim appointment and new board chair, the org-chart character would have no real workload to react to.
platform_copies.video_counterfactual: Unrelated footage would remove the visual sense of escalation that gives the org-chart reaction its comic pressure.

public_fields.caption: CEO out. Interim CEO in. New board chair. The org chart has requested a second monitor.

platform_copies.editorial_angle: The CFO keeping one role while taking the interim CEO role
platform_copies.speaker_perspective: a systems-minded explainer tracking who now owns which job
platform_copies.satire_target: the temporary role design and succession mechanics
platform_copies.semantic_bridge: Colette Kress remains CFO while serving as interim CEO, turning one appointment into a visible two-hat arrangement.
platform_copies.news_counterfactual: Without the CFO's interim appointment, the dual-hat observation and its organizational consequence would vanish.
platform_copies.video_counterfactual: Without the staged visual, the role-stack analogy would lose its visual punctuation but remain a factual leadership explainer.

public_fields.title: NVIDIA's Interim CEO Has Two Jobs. The Org Chart Has Questions.
public_fields.description: Jensen Huang has resigned. CFO Colette Kress will also serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent successor. A look at the leadership reshuffle—and the unusually tidy word used to describe it.

platform_copies.editorial_angle: 换代与换届的字面错位
platform_copies.speaker_perspective: 懂科技产品、也看公司治理的生活化观察者
platform_copies.satire_target: 英伟达管理层调整被产品语境误读的反差
platform_copies.semantic_bridge: “换代”常用于产品，“换届”对应管理层；两字之差把科技公司的人事调整变成一句自然双关。
platform_copies.news_counterfactual: 没有CEO离任与临时接任，“换届”就失去现实锚点，也无法和“换代”形成双关。
platform_copies.video_counterfactual: 换成无关日常素材，双关仍能读懂，但虚构动作视觉对组织震荡的夸张表达会消失。

platform_copies.speaker_perspective: 把公司公告翻译成人话的财经观察者
platform_copies.satire_target: 企业公关措辞与实际组织变化之间的距离

platform_copies.video_counterfactual: 静态公告仍能承载事实，但虚构动作画面会失去把组织变化夸张化的辅助作用。

platform_copies.editorial_angle: 把管理层调整拆成系统角色更新
platform_copies.speaker_perspective: 用工程师视角读公司治理变更的解说者

editorial_reading.primary_satirical_target: The corporate communications language that compresses a multi-part leadership reset into the neutral word “transition.”
editorial_reading.selected_observation: The official announcement bundles a CEO resignation, a CFO becoming interim CEO, and the board’s appointment of its first chair. “Transition” is the neat label; the org chart is doing the heavy lifting.
editorial_reading.visual_role: The owner-described staged action visual is a secondary exaggeration of institutional upheaval. It is not the story, not documentary footage, and not evidence of any real encounter.
editorial_reading.fiction_boundary: The CEO resignation and appointments are official facts. The video is owner-described fictional/staged; its people, actions, setting, media identity and rights remain unverified until the exact file is inspected. Reuters-reported espionage allegations remain unverified and are excluded from the public jokes.
editorial_reading.audience_assumption: Tech/business readers can distinguish CEO, interim CEO and board chair. The joke relies on the gap between a calm corporate noun and several consequential org-chart changes.
rejected_angles: Retell the staged confrontation or describe action beats; that makes the video plot the subject and risks implying real conduct.
Use the espionage allegation as a punchline; it remains unverified and concerns a real person.
Force Jensen, Alice, spy, scandal or AI-parody keywords into every platform variant; that is SEO stuffing and collapses distinct platform voices.
Write a generic celebrity-scandal headline; it discards the specific governance and corporate-language contradiction.
Turn the item into a stock-price recap; this brief concerns succession language, not a trading recommendation.
